description: V3-C13 (stale half). Receipt R-A (digest sha256:aaaa...) was superseded in practice by a newer verification; the signed status snapshot marks it STALE. Reproducibility still says MATCH (the receipt reproduces from its package); the freshness dimension says STALE and the default fail-closed policy rejects it. The two dimensions are reported separately, never collapsed into one score.
title: A stale receipt re-verifies as MATCH but is REJECTED on freshness
